rules.arm_set: U (canonical G3 unbounded), E (G3-E 8 MiB task boundary), CB (CB_SELECTION), F (flat streaming Euclidean 8 MiB = C5 rule), P (BMRM C=8 8 MiB; omitted only if NL03_PROTOCOL_BLOCKED)
rules.order_seed: order a, seed 2711 (confirmation); benchmark orders b, c for U, E, P only if budget allows
rules.training_normals: full train/good (100 %) in chronological (relative_path) order, including CALIB/EVAL roles and the NL-02 SELECTED pool (released after this lock); tau recomputed from full-train counts
rules.ad2_stream: 8 scenarios, alphabetical, one CL stream, fit on train/ only
rules.ad2_threshold: per scenario and arm: theta = max A1 image score over validation/ images at the scenario acquisition stage; binary map = pixel map > theta; no test split used
rules.ad2_maps: final-stage A1 maps (392) bilinearly resized to native resolution; float32 TIFF + binary PNG
rules.metrics: native pixel AP (binned, BENCH-G3 primitives), image AUROC (A1 top-1 %), FM, prequential mean, persistent bytes, update time, inference latency
rules.budget: N-O <= 8 GPU-h wall with auto-stop; priority AD2 package > AD2 test_public > MVTec AD > VisA > MPDD
